title: Geometric-arrow half of finite direct-image factorization
statement:
theorem diagonalTrace_finiteAdjunction_geometric
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (f : diagonalSurface Y ⟶ ProjectiveLine Y)
    (p : Presentation l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f)
    (n : ℕ) :
    let E := ULift.{u} (Padic l)
    let UX := diagonalCompletedUnderlying l (diagonalSurface Y)
    let VX := p.restrictionX.F.mapDerivedCategory
    let VS := p.restrictionS.F.mapDerivedCategory
    let evX := ((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (DiagonalMod l (diagonalSurface Y))).obj
      (op n)).mapDerivedCategory
    let evS := ((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (DiagonalMod l (ProjectiveLine Y))).obj
      (op n)).mapDerivedCategory
    let line := (SpTowerClasses.line l E p.chernX)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧
    let Φ := fun η : UX.obj (completedUnit l (diagonalSurface Y)) ⟶
        evX.obj (VX.obj line) ↦
      p.finitePushUnit l ≫ p.Rf.R.map η ≫ (p.finitePushComparison l n).hom.app line
    ∀ θ : SpTowerClasses.unit (diagonalSurface Y)
          (SpTowerClasses.Arings l E (diagonalSurface Y)) ⟶ line,
        Φ ((p.coefficientsX.unitMap l E p.LX ≫ (p.LX.projection n).app _) ≫
          evX.map (VX.map θ)) =
          (p.coefficientsS.unitMap l E p.LS ≫ (p.LS.projection n).app _) ≫
            evS.map (VS.map
              ((SpTowerShriek.adjunction l E p.base p.model.geometry).homEquiv _ _
                ((p.model.coefficientPullback.derivedIso l E).hom ≫ θ)))

proof.text: Expand the explicit direct-image operation. Naturality of finitePushComparison moves theta to the right. Substitute the coefficient-unit component equation; adjunction naturality combines coefficient pullback with theta.

proof_origin.place: geometric classes proof (3), the actual direct-image operation

mathlib_searches.verdict: The two halves are stated as separate interfaces.

statement_change.what: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: the old assertion quantified an arbitrary function Phi, fixed only on the image of supported classes, then prescribed its values on all geometric classes. Supported classes do not exhaust those inputs. Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic different from l, H^2(P1 x P1,Z/l^(n+1)(1)) has the two ruling classes and the supported diagonal classes span their sum. Altering Phi on a ruling class preserves all supported values. The source constructs one specific direct-image operation; the correction uses that actual operation, and its parent retains its original full existential statement.

citers.note: Its full statement stays unchanged; the proof constructs the canonical direct-image operation and proves its supported equation separately.

old_proof.text: Expand the geometric adjunction hom-equivalence, use the coefficient-pullback derived isomorphism and the exact-cone projection identity, and apply naturality.
The supported equation fixes the normalization of the common operation..
